body.name: Simultaneous branch neighborhoods
body.construction: Conditional on the source-prime chart hypothesis and successful finite output of \(\mathrm{thm:conditional\mbox{-}geometric\mbox{-}resolution}\), construct \(\mathcal A_m\) by mapping a joint Gaussian covariance ellipsoid for \(\pi_G(S_m)\) through every locally labeled component of \(r\), using the implicit derivative \(D r_j(\Sigma)[H]=-D_\Sigma p_e(\Sigma,r_j)[H]/\partial_t p_e(\Sigma,r_j)\).
